definitions.explanation: A place other than here; elsewhere. Often implies somewhere unfamiliar or outside one's group.
People who are not part of one's own group or family.

{余所|よそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。

notes:
{余所|よそ} means 'somewhere else' or 'other people,' carrying a sense of separation — not part of one's own group, place, or concern.

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as よそ. Also written as {他所|よそ}. The kanji spelling {余所|よそ} is common in dictionaries but hiragana is more frequent in everyday use.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{余所|よそ}{見|み}→他所見：16630_yosomi⟧: looking away, getting distracted (especially while driving)
- {余所|よそ}⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: outsider, stranger
- {余所|よそ}⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧: going-out clothes; putting on a formal front
- {余所|よそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: other people, strangers
- {余所|よそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: other people's homes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧: 'other' (more neutral, no connotation of exclusion)
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: another place (neutral)
- {余所|よそ} specifically implies 'outside one's own sphere' — unfamiliar, unrelated, or not one's concern
